title: Trump: 'Fake News' That Top General Against Iran War
description: In a Truth Social post, Trump pushed back on an Axios report hours earlier that said Caine had warned administration officials about the risks of a prolonged conflict if the United States were to strike Tehran’s nuclear facilities.

title: Trump dismisses 'fake' reports of limited strike on Iran to force deal
description: The president previously said he was "considering" a targeted strike as a tactic to force Iran to make a deal with the United States.

title: US orders exit of Beirut embassy personnel amid Iran tension
description: The United States ordered non-emergency staff to leave its embassy in Beirut as US President Donald Trump threatens possible strikes on Iran.

title: Iran would react 'ferociously' to any US attack, warns of regional conflict
description: Iran vowed on Monday to retaliate "ferociously" against any attack from the United States, and repeated its warning of a regional conflagration in response to President Donald Trump's latest threat of strikes.The bellicose rhetoric from both Tehran and Washington came as the foes prepared for indirect talks in Geneva on a potential deal regarding Iran's nuclear programme, after a US official confirmed discussions would resume on Thursday.

title: U.S. tells some of its diplomats and their families to leave Lebanon amid Iran tensions
description: The United States has ordered non-essential diplomats and their family members at the U.S. Embassy in Beirut to leave Lebanon, the State Department said Monday, as tensions over Iran rise with the threat of a potentially imminent military strike.

title: Students in Iran protest for third day
description: Iranian students defied authorities with protests for a third day on Monday, weeks after security forces crushed mass unrest with thousands killed and as the United States weighs possible air strikes against the Islamic Republic.
